m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.activity_or_procedure_title: Modeling the Greenhouse Effect with Two Thermometers
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.objective_or_aim: Demonstrate trapping of heat by trapped infrared radiation.
step_by_step_procedure: Place Thermometer 2 inside inverted glass jar.
Expose both to sunlight for 30 minutes and record temperature every 5 min.
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.expected_observations_or_working: Jar thermometer registers significantly higher temperature.
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.scientific_or_logical_conclusion: Glass traps outgoing thermal infrared radiation, mimicking atmospheric greenhouse gases.

scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Why is Earth described as an open system for energy but a closed system for matter?

scripted_dialogues.speaker: Student
scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Solar shortwave energy enters and longwave heat escapes into space (open for energy), but Earth's chemical elements are fixed in quantity and continuously recycled through biogeochemical cycles (closed for matter).
